newsitem.title: USA: CPC buys Starlux from Group Danone.
newsitem.headline: CPC buys Starlux from Group Danone.

text.p: CPC International Inc said Monday that it has acquired the Starlux business in Spain from the Groupe Danone and Findim Investments SA.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

CPC said that Starlux group had $160 million in annual sales. Its products include Starlux bouillons and Nocilla chocolate hazelnut spreads, both leading Spanish brands in their categories, as well as Starlux meal dishes and tomato products and Suenos de Oro herbal teas. Starlux products are marketed in both the retail and foodservice sectors.
CPC is one of the largest U.S. food companies, with worldwide sales of $9.8 billion in 1996. Its better-known products include Hellmann's mayonnaise, Mazola corn oil and Skippy peanut butter.
